snippet.title: Risk of Rain: Meridian Showcase 3
snippet.description: i have been gone for a while since i was too lazy to upload on this channel but some stuff happened, meridian released! You can grab it today on rainfusion.net and retroPacifist has joined the team, funnily enough these 2 elites were made by him! I think they turned out so good, their names are Rippling and Forsaken, Meridian now has a 5 maps, all listed on the rainfusion page. The music you hear in the background was made by Altzeus it's such a banger to listen too.
